sal.basis: Omani pay is quoted monthly in OMR and is tax-free today (a 5% personal income tax on income above OMR 42,000 a year starts in 2028, Royal Decree 56/2025, as I recall; it would not touch this band). Estimate, not checked against a 2026 salary guide in this run (web search budget used up, page fetches blocked): Senior Financial Analyst / FP&A, ~8 yrs, Muscat, about OMR 1,200-1,800 a month total package for expats; Omani nationals at banks, OQ/PDO and state-owned groups about OMR 1,500-2,300. f = 0.06 maps Noura's 26,000 SAR to OMR 1,560 (Salim's current pay) and the v5 band 34-41k SAR to OMR 2,040-2,460, the upper part of the Omani-national range. At the currency rate alone (1 SAR = ~0.1025 OMR, both pegged to the USD) f would be 0.1025; Muscat pays well below Riyadh for this role, so f is lower. Keep f within 0.05-0.07 when a guide is checked.

rule.en: We skip roles reserved for Omanis, including job titles closed to expatriates, unless you are Omani. If you need a new work visa, we also skip roles that only take candidates already in Oman.
rule.ar: نتخطّى الوظائف المخصّصة للعمانيين، ومنها المهن المقصورة عليهم، إلا إذا كنت عُماني الجنسية. وإذا تحتاج تأشيرة عمل جديدة، نتخطّى بعد الوظائف اللي تطلب مرشحين داخل عُمان.
rule.fr: Nous écartons les postes réservés aux Omanais, y compris les métiers fermés aux expatriés, si vous n'avez pas la nationalité omanaise. Si vous avez besoin d'un nouveau visa de travail, nous écartons aussi les offres réservées aux candidats déjà à Oman.

desc.en: Private employers must keep a minimum share of Omani staff, set by sector and highest in banking, and Ministry of Labour decisions reserve a list of job titles for Omanis only. We only apply to roles marked Omanis only if you are Omani.
desc.ar: الشركات الخاصة لازم تحافظ على نسبة محددة من الموظفين العمانيين حسب القطاع، وأعلاها في البنوك، وقرارات وزارة العمل تقصر قائمة من المهن على العمانيين فقط. وما نقدّم على الوظائف المخصصة للعمانيين إلا إذا كنت عُماني الجنسية.
desc.fr: Les employeurs privés doivent maintenir une part minimale de salariés omanais, fixée par secteur et la plus élevée dans la banque, et des décisions du ministère du Travail réservent une liste de métiers aux seuls Omanais. Nous ne postulons aux offres réservées aux Omanais que si vous avez la nationalité omanaise.

sensitive.notes: Photo: common on Omani and Gulf CVs emailed to recruiters, but not needed on ATS portals; we offer it, never require it, and only send it where a form asks. Gender, date of birth and nationality are standard fields on Omani employer portals (OQ, PDO, banks, Oman Air) and on Bayt and GulfTalent profiles. Nationality also drives Omanisation (Omani-only adverts and job titles closed to expatriates) and work-permit handling. Marital status appears on some Omani CVs and on government forms but is not needed for matching, so we do not ask (conservative; Oman's PDPL, Royal Decree 6/2022, expects data minimisation and treats health, religion and similar data as sensitive). The civil number or resident card number is collected by employers at offer stage, never by us. We never filter on gender or age, only on work rights and Omani-only postings. From general knowledge; not re-verified in this run.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Muscat. I lead IFRS reporting and budgeting on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 40-person function. I built the rolling forecasts and variance analysis that cut our reporting time by a third, and I set up the group's VAT reporting when Oman introduced VAT in 2021. I am looking for a Senior Financial Analyst or FP&A role in Muscat, Sohar, or remote.
bio.ar: محلل مالي بخبرة 8 سنوات في مسقط. أقود تقارير IFRS والموازنة على SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأملك الإقفال الشهري لإدارة من 40 موظفاً. بنيت التوقعات المتحركة وتحليل الانحرافات اللي قلّصت وقت التقارير بالثلث، وأسّست تقارير ضريبة القيمة المضافة للمجموعة لما طبّقت عُمان الضريبة في 2021. أبحث عن وظيفة محلل مالي أول أو تخطيط وتحليل مالي في مسقط أو صحار أو عن بُعد.
bio.fr: Analyste financier avec 8 ans d'expérience à Mascate. Je pilote le reporting IFRS et le budget sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction de 40 personnes. J'ai mis en place les prévisions glissantes et l'analyse des écarts qui ont réduit d'un tiers notre temps de reporting, et j'ai monté le reporting TVA du groupe lors de l'introduction de la TVA à Oman en 2021. Je recherche un poste d'analyste financier senior ou en FP&A à Mascate, à Sohar ou en télétravail.

culture.notes: Work week Sunday to Thursday (Friday-Saturday weekend since 2013); copy should use Sun-Thu days for interviews and deadlines. Salaries are quoted monthly in OMR (3 decimals, 1,000 baisa), tax-free for now, and paid monthly through the Wage Protection System; offers usually split basic pay and allowances (housing, transport). A 5% personal income tax on income above OMR 42,000 a year is due from 2028, so copy must not promise 'tax-free' beyond 2027. Notice: the Labour Law (Royal Decree 53/2023) sets at least 30 days' notice for monthly-paid staff unless the contract says more; 30 days is the safe default, and senior finance contracts often say 60-90. Since 2021 expats no longer need an NOC to change employers once a contract has ended or been ended correctly. Muslim staff work shorter hours in Ramadan (about 6 a day). CVs: 2 pages, English (Arabic for government and some state-owned roles), with a personal block: nationality ('Omani national' up front), visa or residence status for expats, often date of birth and a photo. Cover letters are rarely required; portals ask screening questions instead. Many bank, energy and state-owned finance roles are Omani-only or Omani-preferred, and some job titles are closed to expatriates by Ministry of Labour decision. English is the working language in banks, oil and gas and listed groups; Arabic matters in government. From general knowledge; see OM.sources.md for what still needs verifying.
